prompt:
Assess ISO readiness for: Industry: Chemical Manufacturing, Company Size: 310 employees, Pain Points: Environmental permit violations last year, no aspect/impact register, emergency response plan not tested in 3 years, waste manifests incomplete

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- readinessScore (string): overall ISO readiness score
- gaps (string): identified gaps in current system
- recommendations (string): recommended actions to address gaps
- standards (string): applicable ISO standards

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"readinessScore":"Low","gaps":"Lack of aspect/impact register, untested emergency response plan, incomplete waste manifests, history of environmental permit violations","recommendations":"Develop and implement an aspect/impact register, update and regularly test the emergency response plan, ensure completeness and accuracy of waste manifests, address root causes of past environmental permit violations, consider hiring an ISO consultant for guidance","standards":"ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety), ISO 9001 (Quality Management)"}
